svg.aria-label: Coefficient paths for eight features as the penalty weakens from left to right. Ridge weights all grow smoothly from zero and none is ever exactly zero. Lasso weights stay at exactly zero until the penalty drops below a threshold, so the four true signals enter one by one and the four noise features stay near zero
